title: Home SOC Lab
description: A home lab for collecting endpoint telemetry and building Splunk detections and dashboards.

sections.title: Telemetry collection
sections.text: Integrated Splunk, Sysmon, and Winlogbeat to collect and analyze Windows and Linux security telemetry.

sections.title: Detection and dashboards
sections.text: Used simulated activity to practice identifying authentication anomalies, privilege escalation, and command execution in Splunk.
